title: Causal descent on location-bound lease-succession assets
objective: Determine whether exact-address lease succession creates an independent repeatable commercial boundary or merely improves an incumbent rental handover workflow.
truth_rules: ROUTING KEY VALUE != SEPARATE COMMERCIAL CONTROL PLANE
LANDLORD/PROPERTY PERMISSION IS PART OF THE BOUNDARY

evidence.fact: A July 2026 renter survey reports total housing cost, house condition/furniture-appliance configuration and commute as major decision factors; work/commute change is the leading reported move trigger.
A 2026 China Index Academy renter survey treats furniture and room configuration as part of the rental product and room-quality bundle.
Current Shenzhen transfer listings directly embed furnished state, free successor items and paid appliance transfers inside the rental listing itself.
Used bulky furniture can have transport/dismantling cost that consumes most resale proceeds; one reported example left RMB 260 net after a RMB 700 sale and RMB 440 moving cost.
A consumer case describes a sofa that was difficult even to give away because dismantling/transport was the binding friction, eventually requiring paid removal.
Civil Code lease rules require return of the leased property at expiry in the agreed/normally used state and generally require lessor consent for subletting.

Court guidance recommends explicit furniture/appliance inventories as part of house handover; Ministry of Justice case guidance distinguishes removable tenant-owned furniture and calls for negotiated handling at surrender.

selected_latent_outcomes.outgoing_renter: fast compliant unit clearance with minimum net loss
selected_latent_outcomes.incoming_renter: move-in readiness at acceptable total housing cost
selected_latent_outcomes.landlord_or_property: fast low-risk turnover into a rentable and handover-compliant state

competing_constraints.finding: Bulky low-value assets often lose most residual value to dismantling, transport and disposal cost.
A housing mismatch dominates any furniture benefit; predecessor assets matter only after the dwelling is acceptable.
Timing matters but repeated costly failure specifically caused by overlap is not established.
Condition/inventory is naturally part of lease handover and contracting.
The landlord/property actor controls lease succession and acceptable return state.
Current rental listings already express furnished state, gifting, paid appliance transfer and direct landlord re-signing.

causal_frontier.decision: The exact address can eliminate transport and therefore has routing value, but the flow collapses into the existing rental transaction and landlord/property handover boundary. No independent missing edge is evidenced.
governing_structure: landlord/property controls permission and return state
existing rental listings can carry asset-transfer information

missing_edge.reason: No repeated costly unowned failure is established beyond the capabilities of transfer listings, landlords/brokers/property managers, rental platforms and ordinary local removal/resale channels.

preserve_as: future bounded feature only if direct repeated incumbent failure evidence appears

meta_learning: A new routing key can improve an existing transaction without creating a new business control plane. Reject formations where the new signal is merely an attribute inside an incumbent transaction whose owner already controls permission, handover and settlement.

requirements: prefer value stranded before an incumbent transaction exists
prefer boundaries with no natural controller owning both sides
require the new routing key to change who can transact, not merely enrich an existing listing
look for repeated workaround/failure before product design
do not reopen lease-succession assets without new repeated costly unowned failure evidence
